column1: # One row per (table, row, metric). This is the machine-readable twin of CELL_PROVENANCE.md and
# the input to verify_report.py. Every `source` was resolved by reading the JSON, not by trusting
# the prose -- see the `note` column where the report and the store disagree.
#   table     the report table the cell appears in (A, B, C, D, E, F, F', G, H, I, J, anchor)
#   row       the row label within that table
#   metric    mu | fq | f_rouge | r_ppl | own_prob | own_rouge
#   reported  the value as printed in the report. A leading ~ means order-of-magnitude only
#             (relative tolerance); otherwise tolerance is half a unit in the last printed decimal.
#   run       a40-2026-07-24 (the original sprint-cluster A40 study, snapshotted here)
#             its JSONs live on that cluster, so these rows are recorded, not verified)
#             mean    -- arithmetic mean of a field over every JSON matching a glob
#             single  -- one probe row standing in for a whole-table cell (see note)
#             reband  -- a recombination; resolves to another cell, given as table/row/metric
#             external-- produced outside this repo; carries a citation, not a number to check
#   source    <pool>/results/<tier>/<file>.json:<field>, or a glob for `mean`, or a cell ref
#   note      anything a re-deriver would otherwise get wrong
